## Division 1: Kelvin Cameo Resort Hotel & Banquets (Hospitality)
- **URL**: https://kelvincameo.com/hospitality/
- **Description**: Premier boutique luxury resort hotel, event venue, and private recreation center in Suleja, Niger State.
- **Room Categories & Nightly Rates**:
  - **Standard Room**: ₦25,000 / night. Cozy comfort with queen bed, ensuite bath, air conditioning, and satellite TV.
  - **Deluxe Room (The Annex)**: ₦40,000 / night. Contemporary suite with marble workstation desk, wardrobe, wall-mounted satellite LED TV, and ensuite bath with water heater and glass shower.
  - **Executive Room**: ₦60,000 / night. Spacious executive quarters with seating lounge, king bed, workstation, mini-fridge, and luxury bathroom.
  - **Blissful Breeze Suite**: ₦120,000 / night. VIP suite with plush living room, private bar counter, premium king mattress, ambient lighting, and panoramic resort views.
  - **Presidential Penthouse Suite**: ₦200,000 / night. Ultimate presidential hospitality with multi-room layout, master king bedroom, dining area, jacuzzi bath, and bespoke butler service.
- **Recreational & Event Facilities**:
  - **Resort Swimming Pool & Pergola**: Outdoor azure pool featuring active fountain water jets, poolside bar & grill, and covered ivy pergola lounge. Complimentary for resident hotel guests; visiting non-residents can purchase a day pass for ₦3,000.
  - **1,000-Seat Grand Banquet Hall**: Niger State's premier event auditorium equipped with crystal chandeliers, acoustic ceiling, stage, VIP greenrooms, and conference audiovisual setup. Suitable for high-society weddings, corporate AGMs, government summits, and banquets.
  - **Cameo Restaurant & Grill**: Specializing in fresh catfish point-and-kill, traditional Nigerian pepper soups, jollof rice, assorted meats, and continental favorites.
  - **VIP Cocktail Bar & Billiards Lounge**: Full-service cocktail bar with domestic and imported beverages, plus professional snooker and pool tables.
- **Operational Guarantees**:
  - **Power**: 100% uninterrupted 24/7 electricity powered by dual synchronized 250kVA standby diesel generators.
  - **Security**: 24-hour armed perimeter guard detachment, motorized gate entry, and CCTV surveillance.
  - **Internet**: High-speed fiber-optic Wi-Fi covering all rooms, gardens, and banquet halls.
  - **Parking**: On-site secure parking for over 200 cars and buses.
  - **Check-in / Check-out**: Check-in from 14:00 (2:00 PM); Check-out until 12:00 (12:00 PM).
  - **Reservations & Booking**: Instant online reservation via Paystack, bank transfer, or 24/7 WhatsApp front desk at +234 805 555 8197.

## Division 2: Kelvin Cameo Energy (Petroleum & Haulage)
- **URL**: https://kelvincameo.com/energy/
- **Description**: Downstream petroleum retail marketing, certified pump calibration, bulk diesel haulage, and clean LPG distribution.
- **Services & Infrastructure**:
  - **Retail Filling Stations**: Ultra-modern multi-pump stations serving PMS (Petrol), AGO (Diesel), and DPK (Kerosene).
  - **Digital Meter Guarantee**: 100% digitally calibrated pumps tested daily; guaranteed zero-under-dispensing so 10 Liters paid is exactly 10 Liters dispensed.
  - **Bulk Haulage Tanker Fleet**: Fleet of heavy-duty 33,000-Liter to 45,000-Liter MAN Diesel tankers delivering certified diesel and fuels across northern and central Nigeria.
  - **Diesel At Doorstep (Mobile Pedier Delivery)**: Mobile fuel pedier dispenser trucks delivering diesel directly to corporate offices, telecom cell towers, construction sites, and manufacturing plants.
  - **Cameo Clean LPG Skid Plants**: Fast, secure cooking gas cylinder refills with automated weight-based scales.

## Division 4: Kelvin Cameo Agriculture
- **URL**: https://kelvincameo.com/agriculture/
- **Description**: Commercial mechanized farming, livestock rearing, automated poultry egg production, and grain storage.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - **Automated Poultry Complex**: 50,000-layer automated poultry battery cage facility supplying fresh farm eggs daily to wholesale distributors across Niger State and Abuja.
  - **Mechanized Arable Farming**: Large-scale commercial cultivation of maize, soybeans, and grains using modern tractors and irrigation systems.
  - **Feed Milling & Silo Storage**: In-house feed compounding and aerated grain silos ensuring year-round supply stability.
